aded by its assertions.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/evals.md:143:When attachments are present, a note is automatically prepended

x. Every click and text input you make in the widget is captured as a locator-stable `interact` step and appended to the case. The
locator is built from stable identifiers in priority order: `data-testid` → ARIA role + accessible name → visible text → CSS path
. This means the recorded step resolves to the same element when the case runs headlessly.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/evals.md:1
